trap-nonspeakable.notes: CHECKS, one genuine discrepancy. (1) VERIFIED: the trefoil complement is Seifert fibred, hence not hyperbolic; the shapes z_0 = -1, z_1 = 2 are the standard degenerate triple {-1, 1/2, 2} closed under z -> 1/(1-z) -> (z-1)/z, all real, and the Bloch-Wigner dilogarithm vanishes on reals, so total volume 0 is right. (2) VERIFIED: the 7_1 row is exactly correct — disc(x^3 + 3x^2 - 4x + 1) = 49, the same discriminant as the cyclotomic cubic x^3 + x^2 - 2x - 1, so it does generate the real cyclotomic field of conductor 7, and all three roots are real. (3) DISCREPANCY in the field pattern the block claims ('the fields are the real cyclotomic subfields the torus type predicts'). Three of four rows fit conductor = mn: T(2,3) -> Q(zeta_6)+ = Q; T(2,5) -> Q(zeta_10)+ = Q(sqrt 5); T(2,7) -> Q(zeta_14)+ = the conductor-7 cubic. The fourth does not: T(3,4) has conductor 12 and Q(zeta_12)+ = Q(sqrt 3), but the row lists Q(sqrt 2), which is Q(zeta_8)+. Either the 8_19 shapes (1 + sqrt 2, -1 + sqrt 2, -1) are from a different triangulation than the pattern assumes, or the 'the torus type predicts' claim needs the (3,4) case excepted. Worth one check before the sentence is relied on. (4) 8_19 is indeed the (3,4) torus knot, and the Neumann-Reid caveat is correct and carefully put. (5) RENDER ADVISORY: the table uses \operatorname{Im}; see the chapter-wide note on gluing-certification-mechanical-reach.
